correctness.rationale: For n>=3, conditioning on one vertex outdegree d leaves d(N-d) independent fair crossing orientations; T|D=d is exactly Bin(d(N-d),1/2), yielding the joint and posterior formulas. The ratio w(b,t+1)/w(b,t)=(q_b-t)/(t+1) rises strictly in b on support; q_b strictly increases for b<=floor(N/2), and support loses every b<m after t>q_{m-1}. This proves likelihood-ratio order, exact strictness and parity plateau. Global reversal provides D|T symmetry, variance is expectation of strictly decreasing (N/2-B)^2, and Bernoulli fourth moments yield Cov((D-N/2)^2,T)=-N(N-1)/16. Exact independent enumeration over all tournaments of n=3..7 passed 681 assertion groups; finite checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: This supplies the full finite-sample conditional distribution and monotone likelihood-ratio (not merely expectation) ordering of the natural competitive balance score from a local cycle observation, with a complete strict/plateau parity classification for all tournament sizes. The raw outdegree has exactly constant conditional mean and zero covariance with cycle count, yet strictly contracting conditional variance: a substantive hidden-dependence phenomenon. It treats a natural unconditional random-tournament statistic, not an arbitrary parameter slice; although the kernel manipulation is elementary, the combined exact characterization and sharp boundaries add interpretive value.
